Welcome to my portfolio for **MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics** at the
University of Pennsylvania.

This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program —
weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to
urban policy questions.

## About Me

I'm a PhD candidate of City and Regional Planning at the University of Pennsylvania. My research develops computational, spatial, and visual analytic approaches to support planners in optimizing complex urban systems when goals conflict and uncertainty is unavoidable. Situated at the intersection of planning, transportation, and public health, I develop analytical frameworks that integrate large-scale administrative and operational data, high-resolution spatial modeling, and visualization for communication to support more transparent and interpretable planning decisions.
